columns.name: coverage_ratio
columns.default:
CASE
    WHEN ((reported_reply_count)::numeric > (0)::numeric) THEN LEAST((1)::numeric, ((retrieved_reply_count)::numeric / (reported_reply_count)::numeric))
    ELSE NULL::numeric
END

columns.name: address_identity
columns.default:
CASE
    WHEN ("left"(contract_address, 2) = '0x'::text) THEN lower(contract_address)
    ELSE contract_address
END
